notes: S1.3 incorrectly states that both in_ready and out_valid are pure functions of current occupancy. While out_valid depends only on whether occupancy is nonzero, the trusted ready/valid semantics require in_ready to also depend on whether a current output transfer can occur. In particular, when occupancy is two, in_ready depends on out_ready. S2.2 later gives the correct formula, but this does not erase the earlier specification-level error. S3.4 also independently overstates backpressure as requiring no state change, but S1.3 is the earliest substantive error. Final RTL passes trusted simulation and bounded formal verification.
